static.population_scope: candidate-complete subset of the released validation file; not a full-validation result
static.partition: 117 incomplete-candidate qids excluded before disjoint 1162-qid calibration and 1162-qid reporting partitions
static.definitive_routing: fixed refusal becomes a typed status without RepairRead; deterministic rejection of an unsupported non-refusal triggers at most one RepairRead
static.metric: dynamic-aligned bidirectional substring EM after lowercasing and whitespace normalization for every initial and RepairRead output; short-answer and punctuation/article normalization is restricted to complementary F1 and ANLS; empty outputs and the fixed refusal receive zero
static.learned_router_evaluation: descriptive diagnostic only; training labels, inner-validation early stopping, and the median baseline-row OOF threshold use calibration qids only; reporting labels are unused until evaluation; +0.09 pp EM with CI including zero at +0.493 calls/q does not dominate deterministic routing
static.counterfactual_rows: training augmentation on calibration qids only; features recomputed against the exact calibration packet; zero counterfactual reader outputs at reporting time
static.reread_prompt: archived best-guess template, not the dynamic copy-focused repair prompt; strict lexical admission follows either generation

dynamic.factual_consumer_rule: retrieval, planning, and synthesis read only the FACT projection; REFUSAL and NO_COMMIT remain audit-visible STATUS records
dynamic.router_scope: archived compatibility diagnostic; no router-only trigger occurred and no causal compute effect is attributed; not required for the lexical guarantee
dynamic.definitive_routing: deterministic lexical admission and at most one RepairRead after a parse failure or unsupported non-refusal; initial refusals become STATUS without repair
dynamic.repair_prompt: frozen dynamic_repair; contains a yes/no generation permission, with no gate bypass
dynamic.final_support_retry: Check and repair only the user-facing final answer; retain all Vanilla intermediate and pre-repair terminal memory records without output-driven replacement.
dynamic.task_question: PlanRAG intermediate: current subquestion; ReAct/AutoGen and terminal admission: main question. Initial synthesis can prepend admitted findings, but terminal repair uses the main question without the findings preamble.
dynamic.memory_adapter: FACT projection returns answer-value content by write position; surrounding logs retain subquestion/search/turn labels and packet pointers. PlanRAG synthesis joins each FACT value to its original sub_q. These links are context, not certified relations.

loop_limits.react: forced first search, then FINISH or 5 search turns; final synthesis
loop_limits.planrag: one plan, exactly 2 subquestions (fixed fallback on parse failure), then synthesis
loop_limits.autogen: forced first request, then STOP/unparseable request or 5 retrieval turns; final synthesis

dynamic.hard_refusal_continuation: A failed-repair refusal becomes STATUS; it does not directly abort the agent loop.

admission.refusal_action: record as non-factual STATUS without RepairRead; exclude from factual prompts and lexical contamination
admission.factual_consumer_rule: reuse only records whose memory_status is COMMIT or diagnostic COMMIT_DIAGNOSTIC_FAIL_OPEN; ignore REFUSAL and NO_COMMIT as factual content
admission.repair_fail_definition: RepairRead returns a refusal or a non-refusal value that fails the strict lexical check

metrics.contamination: trajectory contains at least one admitted non-refusal content write, including the terminal memory write, without normalized-substring support in its exact delivered OCR/text packet
metrics.no_commit: trajectory contains at least one [NO_COMMIT] memory action
metrics.calls_q: initial and repair reader invocations per query; excludes planning and reasoning invocations; model-based verifier costs are reported separately
metrics.dynamic_raw_em: normalized bidirectional substring EM; empty outputs and the fixed refusal receive zero
metrics.static_em: dynamic-aligned bidirectional substring EM after lowercasing and whitespace normalization for every initial and RepairRead output; empty outputs and the fixed refusal receive zero
metrics.word_boundary_sensitivity: diagnostic only: same refusal-aware normalization and bidirectional substring containment, with Unicode word boundaries at both ends of the contained string; not a semantic accuracy metric
metrics.admitted_write_rate: Admitted content writes / all proposed intermediate and terminal writes, including initial refusals; policy-common availability measure, unlike Any NO_COMMIT
metrics.gate_boundary_audit: Character-interior matching diagnostic, distinct from answer scoring; 1318/1321 final ADMIT content writes recoverable, 323 verified against recorded packet hashes, 995 card-ID reconstructions, 3 unreproduced recorded hashes excluded; no gate or output changes

scoring_revision: 2026-10-20: fixed refusals receive zero substring EM; saved generations and admission actions unchanged
metric_scope_revision: 2026-10-20: terminal memory records included in typed trajectory contamination; primary answer scores, generations, decisions and calls unchanged
final_support_contract_revision: 2026-10-20: normalize typed and reused legacy rows to the same preserved-Vanilla memory policy; exact-reader lexical support has no binary-answer exception. Generations, primary answer scores and reader calls unchanged.
